Class UnimarcFunctionalAnalyzer

java.lang.Object
de.gwdg.metadataqa.marc.analysis.functional.FunctionalAnalyzer
de.gwdg.metadataqa.marc.analysis.functional.UnimarcFunctionalAnalyzer
public class UnimarcFunctionalAnalyzer extends FunctionalAnalyzer
Analyzes a UNIMARC record and counts the FRBR functions. In other words, it counts how many FRBR user tasks are supported by the provided record.
